svg.title: Blueprint 8 — Interactive FRBR Visual Relation Graph (/graph) Traversal & Visibility Engine
svg.desc: Graph traversal and data-flow diagram for iqoqo v1.2.0 showing UI anchor launch, GET /api/catalog/graph validation, Item visibility pruning, bounded 1–4 hop BFS traversal up to 150 nodes, 7 cross-schema edge categories, and interactive FRBRRelationGraph canvas.
svg.text: Blueprint 8 — Interactive FRBR Visual Relation Graph (/graph) Traversal & Visibility Engine
iqoqo v1.2.0 • Bounded 1–4 Hop BFS Neighborhood Expansion, Fail-Closed Item Visibility & 7 Cross-Schema Edge Categories

g.text: Entry points across all 4 FRBR entity pages:
• Unauthorized Anchor Item → HTTP 404 Not Found
• Hidden Neighbor Items → Silently pruned in SQL/BFS
1. Initializes FIFO queue at (anchor, hop=0) with visited set
2. Expands adjacent nodes across enabled edge_types
3. Uses batched frontier queries + selectinload (no N+1)
4. Filters every Item node via Step 3 Visibility Gate
5. Terminates at hop == depth OR len(nodes) >= 150
Sets meta.truncated = true if node budget (150) is hit
• Category Toggle Chips (enable/disable any of 7 edge types)
• Live Node Label Search Highlight & Pan/Zoom Controls
• Truncation Warning Banner when meta.truncated == true
Re-anchors BFS traversal on clicked entity via URL state
